text: Priya (PM): Hey team — quick design check before I send to UX reviewers. Two variants for the usage/billing view: Variant A puts the token breakdown legend inline above the chart; Variant B collapses the legend into a hover tooltip and gives the chart the full width. Thoughts on clarity, accessibility, and which scales better for org vs workspace views? Evan (Design): Variant A feels clearer at glance for new users. legend inline reduces cognitive load. But it eats vertical space on mobile. Screenshot: https://nowhere.example/cc1 (mock) :eyes: Lena (Eng): Mobile is tight — inline legend will push the chart below the fold for some orgs with long names. Also variable-length project names break the card grid. We can truncate and show tooltip but engineering cost increases. Kai (Data): Quick usage stat: ~68% of requests for billing page are org-scoped, but 40% of active accounts only look at a single project. Maybe default to org-level but keep a prominent scope switch. Priya (PM): Good data, Kai. What about the scope switch placement? currently it's top-right small toggle. Proposal: move to left of the chart title so it's grouped with context. Evan (Design): Agree move to left. Also propose a11y/color-nit: current palette uses red/orange that are problematic for deuteranopia. Suggest palette: #3772FF, #00B389, #FFD166 (blue, teal, warm yellow). Also add explicit aria-describedby for legend items. Example: ```html Breakdown: prompt tokens, completion tokens, embeddings``` Sam (Support): Please ensure the invoice download CTA is accessible by keyboard and reads as "Download invoice CSV" by default. A lot of customers ask for CSV export rather than PDF. Also request: include alt text for charts in the invoice email attachment. Lena (Eng): Implementation notes: if we put legend inline we need virtualized list for long project lists in tooltip. Also for hover tooltips we should include a persistent legend for keyboard users (not only hover). Evan (Design): Good call. Alternate approach: collapsed legend for small screens, inline for desktop. For keyboard users show a collapsed, focusable legend panel (aria-hidden false when focused). Kai (Data): Also flag: token breakdown naming — customers get confused by "prompt" vs "input" tokens. Suggest copy tweak to be consistent across billing, API docs, and invoice: use "prompt (input) tokens" and "completion (generated) tokens". Priya (PM): Nice. Can design update microcopy accordingly and add a short tooltip explanation? Evan (Design): Yup. Microcopy draft: "Prompt (input): tokens sent in requests. Completion (generated): tokens produced by the model." Keep it <120 chars. Sam (Support): Accessibility nit: contrast for the chart label against background is 3.2:1 currently. Need >=4.5:1 for small text. Please increase weight or change color. Evan (Design): Can do. I'll push a variant with adjusted colors and a mobile fallback where legend becomes an accordion above the chart. Priya (PM): Lena, what's the rough ETA to prototype both variants in the staging console? Lena (Eng): I can get a thin prototype up in 3 business days (chart + scope toggle + csv download). Full keyboard/a11y fixes next sprint. console-bot: deploy-check — no outstanding blocker comments on the design branch. :white_check_mark: Priya (PM): Awesome. Next steps: Evan to upload Figma with color/a11y notes, Kai to confirm default scope rules, Lena to prototype, Sam to add support docs bullet points. I'll schedule a short sync Friday for sign-off. :thumbsup:
